sources.title: Document number rules for Dutch passport and identity card
sources.notes: Universal layout: 9 chars, pos 1-2 letters, pos 3-8 letters/digits, pos 9 digit. Letter 'O' never used. Digit '0' not used in documents issued from 1 Dec 2019.

sources.title: Kenmerken Nederlandse identiteitskaart 2021
sources.notes: 2021 ID card model introduced 2 Aug 2021. CAN number from 2021-01-04. BSN visible via QR / readable area.

sources.title: Kenmerkenbrochure Nederlandse paspoorten 2021
sources.notes: National passport model 2021 issued from 30 Aug 2021. Phased rollout of other models in November 2021.

sources.title: Dutch passport model 2024
sources.notes: Same RvIG document-number rules: pos 1-2 letters, no O, no 0, pos 9 digit 1-9. ICAO MRZ check digit unchanged.

sources.title: Doc 9303 — Machine Readable Travel Documents
sources.notes: TD1 (3x30) and TD3 (2x44) MRZ structure. Check digit weights [7,3,1]. '<' counts as 0, A-Z as 10-35, digits as themselves.

sources.title: BSN structure and elfproef
sources.notes: 9 digits. Weights [9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,-1]. Sum mod 11 = 0 and sum > 0.

sources.title: Dutch driving licence model 2025
sources.notes: No public checksum is published for the driving licence number. Public validation is structure-only.

sources.title: Driving licence one-line MRZ public surface
sources.notes: No publicly documented grammar for the full one-line MRZ. Treat as not_checked.
